name: Gmail
description: Gmail is Google's email service for messages, threads, labels, drafts, attachments, and mailbox settings.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact Gmail account through Relay's verified confidential Google OAuth client with only gmail.readonly and gmail.compose, then let agents search/read bounded mail, list labels, create drafts, and send exact reviewed messages. Relay excludes attachments, mailbox mutation, settings, deletion, bulk export, raw APIs, broader scopes, and model training.

credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay-owned verified confidential Google OAuth client ID configured only on Railway.

capabilities.label: Read email
capabilities.description: Search and inspect bounded Gmail message content and labels.

capabilities.label: Send email
capabilities.description: Send exact reviewed messages under approval policy.

allowed.label: Search messages
allowed.description: Search at most twenty-five messages and return bounded headers/snippets.

allowed.label: Read message
allowed.description: Read one exact message with a bounded plain-text excerpt and no attachments.

allowed.label: Create draft
allowed.description: Create one bounded plain-text draft for explicit recipients without sending.

approvalRequired.label: Send message
approvalRequired.description: Send one exact reviewed bounded plain-text message to explicit recipients.

blocked.label: Modify mailbox
blocked.description: Label mutation, archive, trash, delete, import, insert, batch mutation, history, forwarding, filters, delegates, settings, and administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Export mail
blocked.description: Bulk export, automatic pagination, attachment retrieval, long-term caching, scraping, and model training are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw Gmail API
blocked.description: Arbitrary methods, paths, queries, MIME, raw provider/MCP tools, broader scopes, and credentials are outside V1.

blocked.label: Send unsolicited mail
blocked.description: Spam, bulk commercial mail, credential/token transmission, and bypass of Gmail abuse or safety controls are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads and draft creation are direct; exact sends require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All five selected tools run without per-action approval while exact scopes/account, bounds, recipient checks, audit, and provider controls remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts five fixed Gmail wrappers and attaches refreshed OAuth access tokens server-side.
Relay mounts five fixed Gmail wrappers and attaches refreshed OAuth access tokens server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's production Google Cloud project, confidential web client, verified brand/domains, restricted-scope review, applicable CASA assessment, exact Railway callback, credentials, privacy/Limited Use disclosures, and authorized staging accounts are required.
providerSetup.nextAction: Complete Google restricted-scope verification and applicable security assessment for exactly gmail.readonly and gmail.compose, configure Railway OAuth, then validate account binding, refresh/revoke, denial, quota, read/draft/send semantics, and data deletion handling.

evidence.supports: Google documents Gmail OAuth scopes, restricted-scope verification, and security-assessment requirements when restricted data is transmitted or stored server-side.
Google documents messages, labels, drafts, and send REST methods used by Relay's fixed wrappers.

Google explicitly permits productivity features including user-facing generative summaries while imposing minimum-scope, prominent disclosure, Limited Use, security, deletion, no-training, and anti-spam requirements.
Google documents annual CASA-based security assessment requirements for applications using restricted scopes.
